title.narrative: Strengthening Primary and Emergency health Care services in Rural Homs

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project’s identified needs, targeted locations, and proposed services are fully aligned with the 2025 Syria Humanitarian Response Plan allocation priorities, specifically Envelope 1-2: Supporting Safe and Dignified Return from Areas of Displacement to Areas of Origin. The interventions are designed to ensure that returnees and communities in their areas of origin have equitable access to protection, essential health services, and livelihood-enabling support—paving the way for a safe, voluntary, and dignified return.ltbrgtThe project aims to restore and strengthen access to essential health care services for vulnerable populations in the towns of Al-Qusayr and Furqlus in rural Homs, Syria—areas that have endured years of conflict, displacement, and systemic underinvestment. Building on the association’s proven track record in mobile medical interventions, the initiative will revitalize primary and mental health care, enhance emergency response systems, support patients with chronic conditions, and improve infrastructure resilience.ltbrgtAccording to the 2025 Humanitarian Needs Overview, 16.7 million people across Syria require humanitarian assistance, with nearly 15 million in urgent need of health care. Nationally, only 59% of hospitals and 57% of primary health care facilities remain fully functional, while over 70% of qualified health professionals—including mental health specialists—have left the country. These challenges are especially acute in Homs Governorate, where rural areas like Al-Qusayr and Furqlus face severe shortages in medical personnel, equipment, and reliable infrastructure.ltbrgtKey Activities:ltbrgt1. Primary Health Care Revitalization Reactivate and operate Ministry of Health-affiliated health centers in Al-Qusayr and Furqlus, ensuring access to general medical consultations, maternal and child health services, and chronic disease management.ltbrgt2. Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) Deliver basic mental health consultations, psychosocial support sessions, and establish referral pathways to specialized care—addressing a critical gap in a region where mental health professionals are nearly absent.ltbrgt3. Emergency Medical Response Equip 2 ambulances cars related to DOH with essential medical and technical tools to improve emergency response times and ensure safe patient transport, especially in remote or conflict-affected areas.ltbrgt4. Infrastructure Resilience Install alternative energy systems ( solar panels) to guarantee uninterrupted service delivery amid chronic power outages, and improve water and sanitation systems within health in 2 DOH's health centers in Al Quasiar and Al Foruqlous.ltbrgt5. Specialized Dialysis Services Provide free dialysis treatment for patients with kidney failure through the association’s specialized dialysis center in Homs.ltbrgt6. Ongoing Patient Support for Kidney Failure Offer comprehensive support to dialysis patients, including follow-up consultations, medication coverage, transportation assistance, and psychosocial support, all delivered via the association’s kidney center. This ensures continuity of care for a highly vulnerable patient group that requires consistent, long-term medical intervention.ltbrgtAll of the mentioned health services will be provided by 1 family well -being center in al AL- Quasiar and 2 medical mobile teams ltbrgtThe first medical mobile team will target village and towns in al Quasiar including: Al-Ghassaniyah , Eastern Al-Budayiyah, Aabel ,Al-Hamidiyah , Al-Mubarakiyah Al-Dab’ah ,Al-Salihiyah ltbrgtThe first medical mobile team will target village and towns in Al Foruqlous including: Al-Sabuniyah , Hawlayya , Al-Mallahah , Jubb al-Shamali ,Al-Zakm ,Ghalwat al-Zakmltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe proposed budget of $460,011.73 will directly support the delivery of primary health services to 79,030 beneficiaries, mental health support to 8,100 individuals, and dialysis care for 2,025 kidney failure patients, while also equipping DOH facilities with sustainable infrastructure and lifesaving emergency tools.ltbrgtlt/pgt
